name: @openwop/copilot-provider
description: ADR 0757 — the GitHub Copilot sidecar for RFC 0121 subscription dispatch. A loopback OpenAI-compatible SSE endpoint that runs each chat turn through GitHub's official Copilot SDK under the calling user's own OAuth token. Point OPENWOP_COPILOT_ENDPOINT at it. NOT part of the app build; not imported by backend/ or frontend/.
